content.text: Summary: I read T-5002, listed pods in `internal-tools` (all Running/Ready), and checked logs. The oauth2-proxy log clearly shows Azure AD returning `AADSTS7000222: client secret ... are expired` on every `/oauth2/callback` since 08:01 — matching the user-reported symptom (MS login works, then 500 at the portal). Cluster is healthy, so the fix is for IT identity to issue a new client secret, then the team updates the Kubernetes Secret in `internal-tools` and does `kubectl rollout restart` on the oauth2-proxy Deployment. Resolved with cited docs on Secret volume propagation and Deployment rolling updates.
